proposal.comment: [Playbook] We need a licensor IP indemnity for the licensed compounds; as drafted we bear infringement risk on IP we do not control. We can accept the usual exclusions (our unauthorised modifications or combinations) if that helps.

ops.newText: (d) any breach of any representations, warranties or covenants by Array in Article 15 above, and (e) any allegation that the Development, Manufacture, registration, use or Commercialization of a Product in the Ono Territory in accordance with this Agreement infringes or misappropriates the intellectual property rights of any Third Party, except to the extent such Third Party Claims result from the gross negligence or willful misconduct of a Ono Indemnitee.
ops.oldText: (d) any breach of any representations, warranties or covenants by Array in Article 15 above, except to the extent such Third Party Claims result from the gross negligence or willful misconduct of a Ono Indemnitee.

proposal.summary: Array's indemnity in Section 16.2 covers its own territory activities, its clinical studies and breach of Article 15 reps, but not third-party IP infringement claims arising from our licensed exploitation of the Products; Section 11.4 leaves each party to defend infringement actions at its own expense. Our position requires a licensor IP indemnity (fallback: with the usual exclusions and procure/modify/replace remedies).

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Joint ownership is only acceptable with an unrestricted right to exploit. We have limited the consent requirement to activities outside each party's own territory.

ops.newText: each Party may practice, and grant licenses under, any such jointly-owned inventions or intellectual property for any purpose within its own territory, including through its Affiliates, licensees, Sublicensees and contractors, and neither Party shall have the right to enforce or assign such jointly-owned inventions or intellectual property outside its own territory without the prior written consent of the other Party.
ops.oldText: each Party may only practice any such jointly-owned inventions or intellectual property for its own internal purposes, and neither Party shall have the right to enforce, license, or assign such jointly- owned inventions or intellectual property, without the prior written consent of the other Party.

proposal.summary: Section 11.1(c)-(d) creates joint ownership of collaboration IP but restricts each owner to "internal purposes" with no right to license or enforce without consent — joint ownership without an unrestricted right to exploit, which our playbook treats as walk-away territory. We should at minimum secure free exploitation and sublicensing of joint IP in our own territory.

ruleTitle: Ownership of deliverables and Customer Data

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added a mutual liability cap (greater of 12 months' amounts paid and USD 1M) with the standard carve-outs; indemnities, confidentiality and our payment obligations sit outside the cap. As drafted, our direct-damages exposure is unlimited.

ops.newText: PROVIDED, FURTHER, THAT THE FOREGOING LIMITATION OF LIABILITY SHALL NOT APPLY IN THE CASE OF GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT. EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, EACH PARTY'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT EXCEED THE GREATER OF (A) THE AMOUNTS PAID OR PAYABLE BY ONO UNDER THIS AGREEMENT IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE CLAIM AND (B) USD 1,000,000. "EXCLUDED CLAIMS" MEANS A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY OBLIGATIONS UNDER ARTICLE 10, ITS INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS UNDER SECTIONS 16.1 AND 16.2, ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILLFUL MISCONDUCT OR FRAUD, AND ONO'S PAYMENT OBLIGATIONS UNDER ARTICLE VI (WHICH SHALL NOT CONSTITUTE "DAMAGES" FOR PURPOSES OF THIS SECTION).
ops.oldText: PROVIDED, FURTHER, THAT THE FOREGOING LIMITATION OF LIABILITY SHALL NOT APPLY IN THE CASE OF GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT.

proposal.summary: Section 16.5 gives a mutual exclusion of indirect damages but the Agreement contains no aggregate liability cap at all, so our direct-damages exposure (including the broad Article 16.1 product-liability and clinical-trial indemnities) is unlimited. Our position is a mutual cap at the greater of 12 months' fees and USD 1M, with indemnities, confidentiality, gross negligence, wilful misconduct and our payment obligations outside the cap.

quote: UNLESS EXPRESSLY PROVIDED HEREUNDER, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY OR ANY OF ITS RESPECTIVE AFFILIATES AND THEIR RESPECTIVE OFFICERS, DIRECTORS AND EMPLOYEES BE LIABLE UNDER THIS AGREEMENT FOR SPECIAL, INDIRECT, PUNITIVE, INCIDENTAL OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES SUFFERED BY THE OTHER PARTY
rationale: Section 16.5 gives a mutual exclusion of indirect damages but the Agreement contains no aggregate liability cap at all, so our direct-damages exposure (including the broad Article 16.1 product-liability and clinical-trial indemnities) is unlimited. ruleTitle: Limitation of liability — cap, mutuality and carve-outs

quote: except either Party may assign this Agreement without the other Party's consent to an entity that acquires substantially all of the business or assets of the assigning Party, whether by merger, acquisition or otherwise
rationale: Sits at the fallback: mutual right to assign to a successor without consent, and affiliate assignments require consent that may not be unreasonably withheld. There is no Array right to terminate or re-price on our change of control (note that the Section 4.5(b) combination-study restrictions fall away on an Array change of control, which is a separate commercial point).

quote: Ono shall have the right (but not the obligation) to Manufacture and/or package, or engage a Subcontractor to Manufacture, Ono's requirements of particular Materials
rationale: No sole-supplier or requirements obligation binds us; supply from Array is at our election and we may manufacture or subcontract. The exclusivity that does exist (our exclusive licence in the Ono Territory) is in our favour.

quote: as liquidated damages for the breaches described in (a) or (b) above, the otherwise applicable royalty rate with respect to Products shall thereafter be [ * ]
rationale: The only liquidated-damages mechanic runs in our favour (a royalty-rate reduction for specified Array conduct). No liquidated damages or penalties are payable by us.
ruleTitle: Liquidated damages and penalties payable by Customer

quote: Array hereby grants to Ono an exclusive license, with the right to grant sublicenses as provided in Section 2.2
rationale: The grant is exclusive in our territory, extends to Affiliates and to third-party manufacturers acting on our behalf, is not revocable at will, becomes perpetual and irrevocable on expiry, and is transferable to a successor under Section 18.9. Third-party sublicensees and distributors require Array's consent — noted but not redlined.

quote: In addition, in the event that Array terminates this Agreement for Ono's breach pursuant to Section 13.3 during the [ * ], or Ono exercises its right to terminate this Agreement "at will" pursuant to Section 13.2 during the Initial Royalty Term, then neither Ono nor its Affiliates shall Commercialize a Competing Product or grant the right to a licensee or distributor to Commercialize a Competing Product in the Ono Territory prior to the [ * ] anniversary of the date such termination takes effect.
rationale: Section 8.2 restricts us from commercialising defined Competing Products in the Ono Territory during the term (mutual) and, post-termination, for a redacted period. The in-term, mutual, product-specific restriction is within our fallback, but the post-term tail is unquantified — please confirm it is no longer than 12 months and add carve-outs for internal development and acquired businesses.

quote: Commencing on the later of (i) [ * ] of the First Commercial Sale of the Binimetinib Product in the Ono Territory, or (ii) [ * ] of the First Commercial Sale of the Encorafenib Product in the Ono Territory, Ono shall have the right to terminate this Agreement, for any reasons by giving [ * ] advance written notice to Array
rationale: We do have an at-will termination right and Array has none, which is the right direction, but the right is unavailable until a redacted period after First Commercial Sale and the notice period is redacted; exercising it also triggers the Section 8.2 post-term competing-product ban and cost-bearing under Section 14.2(a). Confirm the notice period is 90 days or less and consider deleting the delayed start.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cap inspections at once per 12 months on 30 days' notice at Array's cost. We can move to 15 days' notice if Array needs more flexibility.

ops.newText: no more than once in any twelve (12) month period, to enter the relevant facilities of Ono and its Affiliates during normal business hours and upon at least thirty (30) days' prior written notice, and at Array's cost, to inspect and verify compliance
ops.oldText: to enter the relevant facilities of Ono and its Affiliates during normal business hours and upon reasonable advance notice to inspect and verify compliance

proposal.summary: The Section 4.9 inspection right has no frequency limit, no defined notice period and no cost allocation, and extends to our internal procedures and records; the Section 7.4 royalty audit is properly limited (once per Calendar Year, independent auditor, Array's cost) but does not constrain 4.9. Our position is once per 12 months on 30 days' notice at the auditing party's cost.

quote: Ono shall, and shall require its Affiliates to, permit Array, and/or an authorized representative reasonably acceptable to Ono, to enter the relevant facilities of Ono and its Affiliates during normal business hours and upon reasonable advance notice to inspect and verify compliance with applicable regulatory and other requirements, as well as with this Agreement
rationale: The Section 4.9 inspection right has no frequency limit, no defined notice period and no cost allocation, and extends to our internal procedures and records; the Section 7.4 royalty audit is properly limited (once per Calendar Year, independent auditor, Array's cost) but does not constrain 4.9. Our position is once per 12 months on 30 days' notice at the auditing party's cost.

quote: shall be governed by, and construed and enforced in accordance with, the laws of the State of New York, United States
rationale: New York law is our preferred position. Disputes go to ICC arbitration seated in Osaka if Array demands and in New York if we demand, so the forum is not an adverse foreign seat for us; no change needed.

quote: Array shall not require Ono to place orders directly with a Subcontractor if such Subcontractor is unwilling to fulfill such orders on terms as favorable to Ono as the terms such Subcontractors have extended to Array.
rationale: No MFN obligation burdens us; the only most-favourable-terms language runs in our favour on subcontractor supply terms.

quote: Ono shall pay to Array, on a quarterly basis, a royalty on the Net Sales of Products by Ono, its Affiliates or Sublicensees
rationale: Payments are an upfront fee, milestones and sales-based royalties; there is no minimum purchase, take-or-pay or shortfall mechanic binding us.
ruleTitle: Minimum purchase commitments and volume restrictions on Customer

rationale: The Agreement contains no non-solicitation or no-hire restriction on us, which matches our preferred position.

quote: shall continue in full force and effect, on a Product-by-Product and country-by-country basis until the Secondary Royalty Term with respect to such Product expires
rationale: No automatic renewal or non-renewal notice window; the term runs to royalty expiry, after which our licences become perpetual, fully paid-up and royalty-free.

quote: Each Party shall use Diligent Efforts to cooperate with the other and/or its designee to effect a smooth and orderly transition in the Development, sale and ongoing marketing, promotion and commercialization of the Product in the Ono Territory during the Wind-down Period
rationale: Article 14 is a detailed exit regime, but it runs almost entirely in Array's favour (our data, filings, trademarks and customer lists transfer to Array). On expiry we do obtain perpetual licences under Section 13.1; however there is no Array obligation to provide us transition assistance or to return/export the Data and safety database it holds if we terminate for Array's breach. Worth adding a reciprocal data-return and assistance sentence.
ruleTitle: Post-termination transition assistance and data return

quote: neither Party makes any representation or extends any warranties of any kind either express or implied, including, but not limited to, warranties of merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, noninfringement or validity of any patents issued or pending
rationale: Array gives Effective-Date reps in Article 15 (IP, compliance with law, safety disclosure) but there is no conformance/quality warranty or remedy for the Materials Array supplies under Sections 9.2-9.4, and Section 15.4 disclaims all implied warranties. Confirm the Supply and Quality Agreements will carry a specification-conformance warranty with replace/refund remedies; otherwise we should add one here.

quote: 18.11 Performance. Unless expressly otherwise provided hereunder, each Party or its Affiliates may perform its obligations hereunder through its Affiliates or Subcontractors
rationale: There is no insurance covenant anywhere in the Agreement, although Array manufactures and supplies drug substance and drug product and sponsors clinical studies. We would add a short mutual insurance paragraph in Article 18 (product liability/E&O; certificates on request), which is a low-severity, standard ask.
